title: Senior Product Manager (JetBrains Context)
description: <p>Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.</li> <li>Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.</li> <li>Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.</li> <li>Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.</li> <li>Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.</li> <li>Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.</li> <li>Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.</li> <li>Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.</li> <li>Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.</li> <li>The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.</li> <li>Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.</li> <li>The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.</li> <li>The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.</li> <li>Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.</li> <li>Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.</p> <p>Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.</p> <p><strong><br><br>Why join JetBrains? </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.</li> <li>Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.</li> <li>Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.</li> <li>Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.</li> <li>Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-HYBRID - if you <strong>want</strong> LinkedIn to post your role as hybrid in all the locations where the role is open ---> leave this tag in JD</span><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AA1 </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, International Communications
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>MKTQ427R39</strong></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Databricks is hiring a Director of International Communications to build and scale our global communications strategy. As Databricks grows its footprint, this role will own how that story gets told: new market entries, in-country investments, new offices, customer wins, and local business milestones that build Databricks' reputation market by market. This role will serve as a strategic communications advisor to regional and country leaders in Europe, Asia, and the Americas and will be responsible for the execution of communications programs across those regions. This is a strategic role: turning business momentum into locally resonant news that establishes Databricks as a leader in data and AI around the world.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What This Role Unlocks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Communications advisor to regional leaders – </strong>advise on PR, social, internal comms strategy</li> <li><strong>Regional news at scale</strong> — a dedicated strategy for translating business growth across Europe, Asia, and the Americas into press moments.</li> <li><strong>Local relevance, global consistency</strong> — an approach tailored to each region's media landscape while staying true to Databricks' global product and corporate narrative.</li> <li><strong>Strong in-market presence</strong> — deep relationships with regional leadership, agencies, and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Leadership for regional PR teams</strong> — a dedicated manager and mentor for our international communications leads while building close relationships with U.S. based comms and product leaders.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Impact You Will Have</strong></p> <p><strong>Regional Communications Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own Databricks' international communications strategy across three regions: Europe, Asia, and the Americas (13 countries).</li> <li>Spot and drive market-specific news — expansions, investments, new offices, customer milestones, and partnerships — that builds Databricks' profile in each country.</li> <li>Evolve the communications strategy as the business scales into new and existing regions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Regional Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the connective tissue between global communications strategy and on-the-ground business momentum in every region.</li> <li>Partner with regional business leaders, ensuring strategy reflects local business priorities.</li> <li>Partner with field marketing and country managers to identify stories worth telling on the ground</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership & Agency/Media Relationships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and support Databricks' communications leads internationally; set clear direction and priorities while providing the autonomy to run their markets.</li> <li>Manage PR agency relationships across all 13 covered markets.</li> <li>Build direct relationships with key regional media so each market has the storytelling support it needs to land Databricks' news locally.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in international, regional, or global communications, ideally in enterprise software, cloud, or AI.</li> <li>Proven track record building regional press strategies and driving coverage across multiple international markets.</li> <li>Strong people management experience, with a track record of developing communications professionals across international teams.</li> <li>Experience managing PR agencies across diverse regions and media landscapes.</li> <li>Strong relationship-building skills with senior business leaders and field teams.</li> <li>Sharp news judgment — able to spot and shape a story from business developments like market entries, customer wins, or new offices.</li> <li>Comfort operating across time zones and cultures, balancing global consistency with local relevance.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally as needed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Engineer
description: What is Flagstone? Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work. Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage. A feel for our culture: To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth. That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it. We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three. But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. Does this sound like you? You're a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer specialising in front-end and mobile, who's excited to forge a new way to save! You set the technical bar for React and React Native across a tribe of squads, drive cross-team initiatives, and act as a force multiplier - coaching engineers, shaping architecture, and representing Flagstone in the wider engineering community. What you’ll do: The Staff Engineer will take a leading role in driving front-end and mobile technical strategy across a tribe of 3–5 squads, ensuring the delivery of high-quality systems that meet our business objectives. You'll partner with squads, Engineering Team Leads, and Product to identify how technology can solve business challenges and take a long-term view on company value. You'll also play a crucial role in mentoring and coaching engineers, helping them grow their system design skills and ship robust, scalable solutions. As a technical leader, you'll provide strategic guidance while also contributing hands-on to key projects. This will focus on: Technical Strategy: Set the front-end and mobile technical vision in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads, aligning with wider business objectives. Cross-Squad Leadership: Originate and lead horizontal engineering initiatives across the tribe; author and shepherd RFCs from proposal to adoption. Solution Delivery: Contribute directly to building and maintaining high-quality React and React Native systems while supporting and unblocking other engineers. Architecture & Design: Own cross-platform architecture decisions for web and mobile (React, React Native, TypeScript), ensuring scalable, reliable, and efficient design with a forward-looking approach. Design Systems: Lead the evolution of our shared design system across web and mobile, driving consistency, accessibility, and developer velocity across squads. Mentorship & Multiplier Impact: Coach engineers in system design, coding standards, and testing; start initiatives that others complete; delegate to protect bandwidth for the highest-leverage work. Communities of Practice: Drive adoption of front-end and mobile engineering practices through CoP leadership and engagement across the tribe. Horizon Scanning: Identify emerging front-end and mobile technologies, build proof-of-concepts, and create roadmaps for adoption. Operational Excellence: Champion the "you build it, you run it" philosophy - driving pipeline observability, zero-downtime deployments, robust monitoring, and alerting for front-end applications. Resilience & Performance: Design solution-wide UI resilience (graceful degradation, back-pressure, retry strategies) and own performance standards across web and mobile. Quality, Security & Compliance: Own threat modelling and security hardening for tribe front-end products; maintain high standards through code review, secure coding practices, and risk management. External Representation: Represent Flagstone externally through conference talks, podcasts, or published content; help attract senior engineering talent through your network and reputation. Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, designers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business needs. What you’ll bring: Proven experience in a Staff Engineer (or equivalent) role with a front-end and mobile focus. Deep expertise in React and React Native with TypeScript , including cross-platform architecture. Track record of owning and evolving a design system used across web and mobile applications. Strong system architecture and design skills, with thorough understanding of SOLID principles, TDD, DDD, and software design patterns . Experience designing for resilience and performance at scale (graceful degradation, zero-downtime deployments, observability, performance budgets). Experience with Azure development and cloud-based infrastructure , including CI/CD and pipeline observability. Experience owning threat modelling and security hardening for front-end products; strong grasp of OWASP and secure coding practices. Track record of originating and shepherding cross-team initiatives or RFCs to adoption. Excellent coaching, mentoring, and leadership skills - with evidence of being a force multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor. Strong problem-solving abilities and strategic thinking. Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills. Comfortable representing Flagstone externally (talks, writing, community engagement) - or keen to start. Agile and Scrum practices experience. How we reward you: At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits: Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you. A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods. Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role. Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind Matched pension contributions up to 5% 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay. All are welcome. At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background. title: Regional Operator Education Specialist
description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Role Purpose As Regional Operator Education Specialist you are responsible for the quality and delivery of onboarding for clinical operators across your region, ensuring training maintains a consistently high standard. You support and quality-assure the work carried out by Clinic Trainers, and act as the escalation point for clinical training matters, so that methods, delivery, and assessments stay aligned with global standards. You also contribute to the maintenance of training programs and content, adapting them for local market needs based on central guidelines and frameworks. This is a competency-based training and safety function. A note on this role Medical Education at Neko is growing and its structure is still developing. This is an interim appointment, and the scope described here may change as the wider function takes shape. We will be open with you about any changes as they happen. What You'll Deliver Onboarding quality and escalation Ensure clinical operator onboarding is delivered to a high and consistent standard across your region, aligned with central guidelines and member safety requirements. Run the onboarding cycle: confirm incoming starters with Recruitment, allocate trainers, and monitor daily trainee progress, stepping in early where progression is slow. Hold the decision to pass, extend, or offboard a trainee in your region, alongside the Lead Operator team. Act as the regional escalation point for clinical training quality and safety matters, triaging every case on first pass to distinguish a genuine safety risk from a standard performance gap, and seeing it through to closure including structured improvement plans. Support and coach Clinic Trainers Provide guidance, feedback, and support to Clinic Trainers on training methodology, delivery, and assessment. Hold trainers in your region to one national standard, working with Lead Operators so operational needs are met at the same time. Follow up on trainer performance and development. Support Clinic Trainers in completing Impact Reviews for existing clinical staff in line with Neko’s pillars. Maintain and adapt training programs Maintain training programs and materials as requested, including Sana content, and adapt them to local market needs while staying aligned with global standards and following approval guidelines. Work from one shared source with your counterpart region rather than maintaining separate regional versions, and flag content gaps and inconsistencies centrally rather than resolving them locally in isolation. Deliver or coordinate key clinical skills training within your region, for example Gen II retrofit training, and provide training-plan input into clinic launches and retrofits. Monitor training quality and drive improvement Observe training delivery, provide structured feedback, and follow up on what changes as a result. Run regional training audits and benchmarks against the national standard, identifying gaps and putting forward improvement proposals, including corrective action where an audit finding requires it. Oversee trainers’ records of staff competency sign-off. No operator works unsupervised on a new device until sign-off is confirmed. Feed hiring and training trends back to Recruitment so screening improves from what is seen downstream in training. Partner across the business Work closely with clinic leadership and relevant support functions so training meets operational needs as well as the clinical standard, and act as a regional training voice with Recruitment, clinic leads, and cluster management, syncing regularly to stay aligned nationally. Experience developing or scaling training frameworks to support clinic expansion. Cross-functional collaboration with Recruitment, Operations, or Education teams. A postgraduate certification in a specialist clinical area or in leadership. title: Head of Product
description: About Us We are passionate industry experts in the property risk, compliance and safety management industry providing our leading end-to-end solution QUOODA – A platform for property owners and managers to maintain and manage a single source of truth for their complete property portfolio, covering commercial, residential, education, health, financial, tech, and telecoms sectors. Our platform is used by over 8000 users across trusted industry leaders and is responsible for managing several of the UK's most iconic buildings, such as London's O2 Arena, The Shard, One Blackfriars, and The Cheese Grater to name just a few. The goal of QUOODA is to make it quicker and easier to manage property risk and compliance, providing key information at your fingertips in real-time covering Health & Safety, Fire Safety, Environmental impact, Asset Management, Work Permits and more. The Team Our team is focused on delivering an industry leading platform for our users and providing them with the right features to simplify their tasks. To do this, the team is fully cross-functional and follows agile best practices in a highly collaborative environment - Taking ownership of the platform architecture, infrastructure, and application lifecycle following the 'Build It, Ship It, Own It' philosophy. We currently have several teams made up of engineers, testers, and product owners, and are expanding these as we move closer to our scalability and growth targets. This is an exciting time to join our team, as there are great opportunities to make your mark and influence how we do things as we progress with our expansion. The Role As Head of Product, you are the voice, validator and external face of QUOODA. Engineering owns what gets built and why; you bring the customer and commercial judgement they need to make those decisions well, and you are accountable for ensuring the product meets the bar before it reaches customers. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the CTO and Director of Engineering: you keep them unblocked, informed and well-connected to the commercial and customer context they need. You are the product's spokesperson externally to customers, to sales and new business, and to customer success and you facilitate a direct, unfiltered relationship between engineering and the wider business. You do not sit in the middle: you remove friction, surface context, and validate outcomes. Key Responsibilities Product direction and voice Set and communicate product strategy. Curate and communicate the QUOODA v2 roadmap, reflecting engineering decisions and ensuring the rationale is clearly articulated to the business and market. Be the spokesperson for QUOODA. Represent the product internally and externally through demos, briefings, webinars, customer councils, sales conversations and analyst or prospect engagements. Work closely with the CTO and Director of Engineering. Be their primary point of contact for commercial and customer context. Keep them informed of business priorities, market signals and customer feedback so they can make well-grounded decisions without being pulled into business-facing meetings themselves. Flag blockers, misalignments and communication gaps early. Facilitate prioritisation. Facilitate prioritisation conversations between engineering, commercial and customers. Bring domain and customer context to those decisions, and ensure engineering has what it needs to make well-informed calls. Commercial, customer success and sales partnership Enable sales and new business. Equip the commercial team with messaging, positioning, demo narratives and answers to the hard questions, so they can win against incumbents and triple our customer base by 2030. Partner with customer success. Translate adoption signals, support themes and renewal risk into product decisions, and give CS the roadmap clarity they need to retain and grow accounts. The v1-to-v2 migration Support engineering in leading the migration of 70 customers from QUOODA v1 to v2. Own the customer-facing communication and experience of the migration. Be the named, accountable point of contact for customers throughout the transition, ensuring engineering has the business and customer context needed to sequence and execute it well. Surface migration risk to engineering. Ensure engineering has unfiltered customer insight to inform their parity decisions. Own the customer-facing communication of each change — what is different, why, and what support is available, once engineering has made those calls. Lead the UAT process for QUOODA v2. Be the primary voice from the customer and business perspective on whether the product is ready. Sign off that it meets the bar commercially and functionally in partnership with engineering who hold the technical quality bar. The go/no-go decision is a shared call, and it is explicit. Curate the backlog of known issues. Turn five years of accumulated, hard-won knowledge about v1's gaps into clear intent for v2. Working in an AI-native SDLC Surface context, not tickets. Surface customer problems, commercial outcomes and real-world constraints in a form that is immediately useful to engineers and AI agents. The goal is to enrich engineering's intent, not to originate it. Represent the product-engineering model externally. Help customers, partners and the wider business understand how our product-engineering model works and why it produces better outcomes. Engineering owns the operating model itself; your role is to make it legible and credible to the outside world. Requirements Essential Demonstrable product leadership experience in B2B / enterprise SaaS, ideally with a complex, configurable platform. A credible, confident external presence, comfortable being the face of a product with customers, prospects, sales and CS. Strong commercial instinct: you understand how product decisions drive pipeline, win rates, retention and growth. Experience owning a major product transition, migration or re-platforming with a live customer base. Fluency with (or genuine enthusiasm to embrace) an AI-native, agentic software development lifecycle: working alongside AI coding agents, expressing intent rather than writing exhaustive specs, and evaluating AI-built software. Highly desirable Regulated domain experience, ideally in GRC, risk, compliance, audit, or adjacent regulated enterprise software. Familiarity with API-first, cloud-native product architectures. Hands-on comfort with AI tooling: prototyping, prompting, and defining evaluations to assess output quality. Experience in a private-equity backed or high-growth scale-up environment. Benefits Competitive salary (depending on experience). 25 days annual leave (excluding UK bank holidays). 5% Matched company pension. Vitality private health insurance (includes Vitality membership). 4x salary life cover. Perk Pal retail discounts. Regular virtual and in-person social events. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for writing high-scale, secure, cloud native software, this is an exciting opportunity to grow and help shape the future of our product, platform, and culture. Our platform is used by over 8000 users across trusted industry leaders and is responsible for managing several of the UK's most iconic buildings, such as London's O2 Arena, The Shard, One Blackfriars, and The Cheese Grater to name just a few. The goal of QUOODA is to make it quicker and easier to manage property risk and compliance, providing key information at your fingertips in real-time covering Health & Safety, Fire Safety, Environmental impact, Asset Management, Work Permits and more. The Team Our team is focused on delivering an industry leading platform for our users and providing them with the right features to simplify their tasks. To do this, the team is fully cross-functional and follows agile best practices in a highly collaborative environment - Taking ownership of the platform architecture, infrastructure, and application lifecycle following the 'Build It, Ship It, Own It' philosophy. We currently have several teams made up of engineers, testers, and product owners, and are expanding these as we move closer to our scalability and growth targets. This is an exciting time to join our team, as there are great opportunities to make your mark and influence how we do things as we progress with our expansion. The Role As Head of Product, you are the voice, validator and external face of QUOODA. Engineering owns what gets built and why; you bring the customer and commercial judgement they need to make those decisions well, and you are accountable for ensuring the product meets the bar before it reaches customers. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the CTO and Director of Engineering: you keep them unblocked, informed and well-connected to the commercial and customer context they need. You are the product's spokesperson externally to customers, to sales and new business, and to customer success and you facilitate a direct, unfiltered relationship between engineering and the wider business. You do not sit in the middle: you remove friction, surface context, and validate outcomes. Key Responsibilities Product direction and voice Set and communicate product strategy. Curate and communicate the QUOODA v2 roadmap, reflecting engineering decisions and ensuring the rationale is clearly articulated to the business and market. Be the spokesperson for QUOODA. Represent the product internally and externally through demos, briefings, webinars, customer councils, sales conversations and analyst or prospect engagements. Work closely with the CTO and Director of Engineering. Be their primary point of contact for commercial and customer context. Keep them informed of business priorities, market signals and customer feedback so they can make well-grounded decisions without being pulled into business-facing meetings themselves. Flag blockers, misalignments and communication gaps early. Facilitate prioritisation. Facilitate prioritisation conversations between engineering, commercial and customers. Bring domain and customer context to those decisions, and ensure engineering has what it needs to make well-informed calls. Commercial, customer success and sales partnership Enable sales and new business. Equip the commercial team with messaging, positioning, demo narratives and answers to the hard questions, so they can win against incumbents and triple our customer base by 2030. Partner with customer success. Translate adoption signals, support themes and renewal risk into product decisions, and give CS the roadmap clarity they need to retain and grow accounts. The v1-to-v2 migration Support engineering in leading the migration of 70 customers from QUOODA v1 to v2. Own the customer-facing communication and experience of the migration. Be the named, accountable point of contact for customers throughout the transition, ensuring engineering has the business and customer context needed to sequence and execute it well. Surface migration risk to engineering. Ensure engineering has unfiltered customer insight to inform their parity decisions. Own the customer-facing communication of each change — what is different, why, and what support is available, once engineering has made those calls. Lead the UAT process for QUOODA v2. Be the primary voice from the customer and business perspective on whether the product is ready. Sign off that it meets the bar commercially and functionally in partnership with engineering who hold the technical quality bar. The go/no-go decision is a shared call, and it is explicit. Curate the backlog of known issues. Turn five years of accumulated, hard-won knowledge about v1's gaps into clear intent for v2. Working in an AI-native SDLC Surface context, not tickets. Surface customer problems, commercial outcomes and real-world constraints in a form that is immediately useful to engineers and AI agents. The goal is to enrich engineering's intent, not to originate it. Represent the product-engineering model externally. Help customers, partners and the wider business understand how our product-engineering model works and why it produces better outcomes. Engineering owns the operating model itself; your role is to make it legible and credible to the outside world. Requirements Essential Demonstrable product leadership experience in B2B / enterprise SaaS, ideally with a complex, configurable platform. A credible, confident external presence, comfortable being the face of a product with customers, prospects, sales and CS. Strong commercial instinct: you understand how product decisions drive pipeline, win rates, retention and growth. Experience owning a major product transition, migration or re-platforming with a live customer base. Fluency with (or genuine enthusiasm to embrace) an AI-native, agentic software development lifecycle: working alongside AI coding agents, expressing intent rather than writing exhaustive specs, and evaluating AI-built software. Highly desirable Regulated domain experience, ideally in GRC, risk, compliance, audit, or adjacent regulated enterprise software. Familiarity with API-first, cloud-native product architectures. Hands-on comfort with AI tooling: prototyping, prompting, and defining evaluations to assess output quality. Experience in a private-equity backed or high-growth scale-up environment. Benefits Competitive salary (depending on experience). 25 days annual leave (excluding UK bank holidays). 5% Matched company pension. Vitality private health insurance (includes Vitality membership). 4x salary life cover. Perk Pal retail discounts. Regular virtual and in-person social events. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for writing high-scale, secure, cloud native software, this is an exciting opportunity to grow and help shape the future of our product, platform, and culture. Sustainware is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Design Director (2.5 days p/w)
description: Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. Role: Design Director (part time - 2.5 days a week) Location: London/Hybrid with occasional travel to Birmingham About the role: As Design Director, you'll serve as both brand guardian and strategic creative partner for Client — leading the studio's creative output while building close relationships with senior stakeholders across marketing, communications, and the partnership. This is a director-level role with genuine scope: you'll set the creative vision, maintain brand consistency across all channels, and develop the talent around you. You'll work closely with OLIVER's creative leadership, bringing your expertise to everything from campaign concepting and typographic craft to team coaching and executive presentations. What you will be doing: Lead all visual communications for Client, acting as brand guardian across print, digital, social, and events — ensuring consistency, quality, and strategic alignment at every touchpoint Set the creative vision and direction for the studio, translating complex briefs from senior stakeholders into compelling, sophisticated design solutions Build, mentor, and develop the expectations Drive responsible integration of AI tools across studio workflows, setting quality standards and governance that preserve craft excellence while improving efficiency What you need to be people at all levels Experience presenting creative work to executive and partner-level audiences, with the presence and communication skills to hold a room and advocate for ideas with conviction Deep craft knowledge across print and digital — typography, layout, art direction, and visual storytelling — with the ability to contribute hands-on when the work demands it Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with Figma and contemporary design tooling Experience managing studio-level or project-level production budgets, including supplier relationships and cost oversight Experience integrating AI tools strategically across studio projects and operations, with the ability to set quality standards and governance at studio level Clear understanding of where AI enhances creative output — and where human craft and judgement remain essential Drives thoughtful AI adoption within the team, maintaining rigorous human oversight and mentoring others in responsible, effective use Agentic approach to complex creative and business challenges: systematic, adaptive, and focused on outcomes Req ID: 17936 #LI-JS1 #LI-Director #LI-hybrid title: Software Engineer II - Full-Stack, Storefront
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Why Deliveroo? We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We obsess about building the future of food, whilst using our network as a force for good. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers. Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact. Firstly, the impact that working here will have on your development, allowing you to grow faster than you might elsewhere; secondly, the impact that you can have on Deliveroo, leaving your mark as we scale; and finally, being part of something bigger, through the impact that we make together in our marketplace and communities. About the Role We're hiring an engineer for the Storefront team to build the digital experiences behind merchants' own branded websites and apps. This is an opportunity to work on highly visible, customer-facing products while solving meaningful platform challenges. What you'll do? As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. While you will work with your team and you may lead projects, some of your work will contribute outside of your direct remit. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results. Technical Execution: You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team. You'll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team's systems. Collaboration & Leadership: As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you'll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities. You'll own larger pieces of work, assist with design and technical / implementation choices and influence the roadmap within your team. You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. This will also extend to the current team where you will support the personal growth of colleagues, encouraging efficiency in their roles. Expectations: We want to emphasise that we don't expect you to meet all of the below but would love you to have experience in some of these areas. Pride in readable, well-designed, well-tested software Experience with Go and/or Python Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) Experience with web architecture at scale (20krpm and above) Experience with "NoSQL" data backends and other (Redis, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch, Memcache) Experience solving logistical problems with software Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale — Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast — Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership — Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎 A culture built for builders — High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create — Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. ➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog . We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . title: VP, Paid Search, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3392 - VP, Activation and Delivery, UK </strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>The VP, Paid Search is accountable for leading a high-performing Paid Search team and shaping the strategic direction, delivery excellence, innovation agenda and commercial growth of the channel across a defined client portfolio and the wider MM&D UK business. This VP, Paid Search role will be part of the new Outcomes Activation & Delivery hub, a newly formed team bringing together key clients from across WPP Media focused on delivering measurable business outcome growth for clients.</p> <p>This is a senior leadership role that goes beyond day-to-day channel management. The VP will own Paid Search channel excellence for Outcomes Hub, translating client business challenges into progressive search strategies, and ensuring Paid Search is positioned as a strategic growth lever across performance, customer experience, commerce and broader media transformation.<br>The role requires expert-level Paid Search knowledge, strong commercial judgement, confident client leadership and the ability to build narratives that connect platform innovation, automation, AI, data, measurement and audience behaviour to tangible business outcomes. It also requires a strong understanding of where Paid Search overlaps with Organic Search, Content, Digital PR, AI search environments, and the evolving Total Search proposition.</p> <p>The successful candidate will lead and nurture a thriving search community that is head and shoulders above the competition, consistently meeting the needs of clients while proactively identifying opportunities to surprise, delight and improve outcomes. They will ensure the team has access to the latest tools, training, resources and innovation opportunities, and will play an active role in shaping agency leadership, MM&D UK delivery initiatives, narratives and workstreams.</p> <p><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Leadership, talent and community<br>•    Lead, motivate and develop a high-performing Paid Search team, creating a culture of accountability, curiosity, high standards and continuous improvement.<br>•    Line manage Directors and/or Associate Directors, ensuring every team member has clear objectives, regular performance conversations and meaningful development plans.<br>•    Identify talent gaps across the Paid Search team and work with HR and leadership to recruit, retain and grow talent aligned to the agency's values, client needs and future capability requirements.<br>•    Provide coaching, mentorship and professional development opportunities, helping teams build both technical depth and broader strategic confidence.<br>•    Evangelise best-in-class Paid Search delivery across the team, ensuring people understand what excellent work looks like and feel enabled to deliver it consistently.<br>•    Ensure the Paid Search team is equipped with the knowledge, skills and commercial understanding required to operate within a Total Search environment, including traditional SEO, Generative Search Optimisation (GSO), Commerce Search and Social Search, fostering greater collaboration, integration and client impact across disciplines.<br>•    Manage department resource levels effectively, balancing client demand, team wellbeing, delivery quality, profitability and growth opportunities.<br>•    Develop the global hub relationship, actively improving the range, complexity and quality of tasks the hub can support, while increasing utilisation and embedding clear ways of working.</p> <p>Develop, evolve and champion our market-leading Paid Search proposition<br>•    Define and own the strategic vision for Paid Search across the relevant client portfolio and team, ensuring our approach remains industry-leading, commercially differentiated and aligned to evolving client, consumer and platform behaviours.<br>•    Own channel excellence for the team, setting clear standards for planning, activation, optimisation, governance, testing, measurement, reporting and client-facing recommendations.<br>•    Support the development and execution of the Paid Search proposition and product strategy and roadmap, including new services, frameworks, operating models and best practice approaches that can scale across clients and MM&D UK.<br>•    Champion the use of AI, automation and technology-enabled solutions in a scalable way, developing innovative client-specific solutions that create competitive advantage and unlock new growth opportunities.<br>•    Ensure the team remains at the forefront of innovation across Google, Microsoft, retail media, social search, search marketplaces, emerging search engines and AI-driven search experiences.<br>•    Translate broader client business challenges into Paid Search strategies that address growth, profitability, customer acquisition, demand generation, retention, conversion, market share and customer experience objectives.<br>•    Build proactive growth plans for the client portfolio they are accountable for, identifying opportunities for incremental revenue, scope expansion, product adoption, innovation pilots and strategic transformation.<br>•    Embed a proactive client culture where teams consistently identify opportunities to surprise and delight clients through innovation, improved performance, insight-led thinking, stronger narratives and market-leading recommendations.<br>•    Partner closely with SEO, Content, Digital PR, Analytics, Commerce, Audience and wider media teams to create integrated search solutions that maximise visibility, relevance and performance across the full customer journey.<br>•    Support the evolution of Integrated Search and the broader Total Search approach, connecting Paid Search, Organic Search, content strategy, AI search optimisation and measurement into a more joined-up client proposition.<br>•    Contribute to wider MM&D UK delivery initiatives, narratives and workstreams, ensuring Paid Search thinking is represented in agency-wide transformation, operational improvement, product development and thought leadership activity.<br>•    Work effectively with media partners such as Google, Microsoft and emerging search technologies to deepen capability, secure access to innovation, shape relevant POVs and translate partner developments into client value.<br>•    Bring together the appropriate specialists to ensure the development of appropriate client-specific measurement, attribution and technology solutions that solve paid search challenges and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.<br>•    Cooperate with wider WPP Media teams to elevate search standards, advance the Paid Search practice, shape the search agenda and support delivery of priority initiatives.</p> <p>Client strategy, proactivity and commercial growth<br>•    Act as a senior strategic advisor to client stakeholders, helping them understand how Paid Search can support broader business goals rather than operating as a standalone media channel.<br>•    Lead teams to interrogate client business context, market dynamics, customer behaviour, competitive pressure and commercial objectives, turning those inputs into ambitious but credible Paid Search strategies.<br>•    Ensure clients receive a gold standard product experience that is strategically progressive, data and technology led, commercially grounded and delivered in line with our product narrative.<br>•    Cultivate strong client relationships by providing exceptional operational output, clear strategic direction, proactive recommendations and a strong sense of ownership across every account.<br>•    Identify opportunities for growth across the Paid Search market and within the client portfolio, including new products, new scopes, automation-led efficiencies, performance improvement opportunities and integrated search propositions.<br>•    Identify and lead opportunities to expand Paid Search into broader Integrated Search and Total Search engagements, connecting SEO, Content, Digital PR, Analytics and wider media capabilities to solve client challenges and drive measurable business outcomes.<br>•    Ensure commercial objectives are fulfilled, including income growth, profitability, scope management, accurate forecasting and effective finance processes that reduce risk of write-offs, overspends and avoidable queries.<br>•    Lead Paid Search input into new business activity, codifying processes and reusable narratives that strengthen pitch quality, differentiation and conversion.<br>•    Support the creation of compelling client narratives that explain the role of Paid Search in a Total Search context. Considering a modern search behaviour, integrated planning, AI-enabled discovery, performance growth and customer decision-making.</p> <p>Delivery excellence, governance and operational standards<br>•    Implement best practice across the department by identifying, improving and rolling out processes that raise delivery quality, efficiency, consistency and client confidence.<br>•    Use automation and new technologies to enhance workflow systems, reduce manual effort, improve QA, support faster insight generation and increase the strategic value of team outputs.<br>•    Ensure teams apply robust QA, governance, data security, privacy and risk mitigation standards across all clients and delivery processes.<br>•    Work closely with data and analytics teams to develop sophisticated reporting and measurement frameworks that provide clients with actionable insight, clear performance narratives and business-focused recommendations.<br>•    Maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional and central teams across the agency, ensuring Paid Search is effectively integrated into wider media planning, performance strategy and client transformation programmes.<br>•    Work across MM&D UK to ensure Paid Search is connected into overall marketing strategy, client operating models and agency-wide delivery priorities.<br>•    Act as the point of contact between partners and clients, ensuring clients have appropriate access to support, strategic direction, innovation opportunities and senior escalation routes when required.<br>Industry leadership, reputation and thought leadership<br>•    Represent WPP Media at industry events, conferences, seminars

title: Senior Social Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3054 - Snr MAI Paid Social Manager - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>Wavemaker Worldwide Activation is the digital specialist arm of the worldwide hub. It powers the digital thinking for Wavemakers largest global clients and acts as a central planning and buying team for clients who buy multimarket digital campaigns from one location. Our digital thinking brings together media, data and technology to drive business results for our clients and is directly connected to our most senior global management team offering increased opportunity for senior level exposure.</p> <p><strong>Client Context:</strong></p> <p>Audible is Wavemaker Worldwide’s largest client and one of the world’s favourite platforms for audio content, from podcasts to audio books to Audible Originals. Audible have ambitious growth targets that we will help them achieve through both branding and performance campaigns across four major markets: France, Italy, Germany and Spain giving the applicate an opportunity to work across market and understand how different markets behaviour and respond to media.</p> <p><strong>Role Context:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a specialist in paid social app/MAI campaigns to continue their career as Account Manager. This person will play an integral role in the day-to-day running of a busy client account. They will be required to work with the line manager to help oversee more junior team members with the overall aim of delivering flawless paid social campaigns for clients. The ideal candidate is someone with good working knowledge of paid advertising across one or more of the key social channels (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). The candidate should also have in-depth experience of working with mobile app-install campaigns across Meta, Reddit, Twitter, TikTok and Snapchat and also be proficient in understanding the specific challenges of mobile/app campaign tracking including having worked with MMPs. This person will also be required to develop relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders becoming a trusted voice for all things paid social.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>Account Managers are expected to work closely with their Account Director and the Global Hub team to manage the day-to-day running of one (or more) client accounts. Account Managers have several key areas of focus, these include:</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Developing comprehensive paid social media plans (+ supporting material) that align with client’s objectives and KPIs focussing on mobile app-install campaigns. Able to clearly articulate the rationale for proposed campaign tactics (channels, budget, audience, formats etc.) and present these back, both to internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Responsible for end-to-end set up of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms (and working with junior team members to assist them with this task as necessary), focusing on app-install campaigns. Comfortable using advanced features such as bid rules and 3rd party optimisation/ creative/ measurement tools to achieve results for clients.</li> <li>Responsible for ensuring regular quality assurance (QA) checks are undertaken by everyone working on the account (both locally and in the Global Hub team) to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards.</li> <li>Responsible for monitoring campaign performance and pacing to ensure all activity delivers as expected. Troubleshooting and optimising campaigns in order to improve performance as necessary.</li> <li>Working with Executives, Snr. Executives and the Global Hub team to produce detailed & accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel. Leading client calls to present results as necessary.</li> <li>Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. Should be able to identify trends and recommend actions on-platform to capitalise/mitigate these trends as necessary. Working with junior team members to ensure standards for commentary remain consistent.</li> <li>Producing more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly/annual reviews, and for standalone projects.</li> <li>Owning the tracking of app-install campaigns across social activity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client & Partner Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as a key social point-of-contact for your client(s) ensuring their continuing confidence in the quality of the team and agency’s social output.</li> <li>Demonstrating a deep understanding of the media and technology developments that influence your client’s business. Able to identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space, presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Building and maintaining relationships with the key media partners including Meta, Twitter, Snap, TikTok, Pinterest and others.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Working with your line-manager to ensure the effective management of more junior team members ensuring workloads are sufficiently monitored & prioritised to ensure deadlines are met.</li> <li>Able to communicate clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. Leading presentations where necessary.</li> <li>Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community. Leading by example to motivate and encourage those with less experience.</li> <li>Assisting with the recruitment process for the immediate and wider team. Attending interviews and acting as an ambassador for the team to potential candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space. Presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Working with line-manager to develop and implement testing/learning agendas for clients that drive clear and actionable insight on each social platform.</li> <li>Working closely with planning team + other channel specialists to ensure paid social activity compliments and enhances the wider marketing mix.</li> <li>Responsible for accurate and timely fulfilment of mandatory agency finance processes. Working with junior team members and the Global Hub team to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate who can display the following attributes:</p> <ul> <li>The successful candidate should have experience working in a digital marketing or agency-based role and will need to demonstrate a track record of working with clients or external stakeholders.</li> <li>Extensive experience setting up and optimising paid social campaigns across a number of the key social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). Training certifications in any of the key platforms would be a plus (e.g. Meta Blueprint).</li> <li>Experience planning large-scale paid social campaigns including app-install campaigns with performance objectives.</li> <li>Experience working with mobile measurement platforms (such as Kochava or Appsflyer) and accompanying data-sets.</li> <li>Experience compiling detailed and insightful end of campaign reports & presentations. Knowledge of how to structure regular client review presentations (QBRs, annual reviews etc).</li> <li>Forming strong relationships is key to the role, the ideal candidate should feel comfortable presenting to clients and leading calls as required.</li> <li>Teamwork is key to this role and we are looking for someone who is collaborative, friendly, and with a can-do attitude.</li> <li>Some experience line managing individuals and/or helping to train others across paid social would be preferable.</li> <li>In return the successful candidate can expect to work as a member of a fun and engaging team that is part of a company that truly champions learning, development and will invest in your career over the long term.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Championing Growth and Development</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">

title: Senior Associate, Clients, GCS
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The OpenDoor partnership model is designed to deliver next-level productivity through an industry-leading approach to people, platforms and processes. OpenDoor brings together WPP agencies and disciplines including media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, technology and commerce, public relations and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values draw on Amazon’s <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a> and WPP’s values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, WPP’s creative transformation and Amazon’s customer focus empower our people to challenge today’s conventions and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, you will become part of a cross-functional team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients. You will work in new ways on ambitious opportunities across marketing, technology, media, business and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Client Senior Executive. This full-time, London-based role reports to the Regional Client Associate Director and supports XCM, Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division. The position sits within a regional team that works remotely across the UK and Germany, with the line manager based in DE and regular collaboration with colleagues and local market teams across Europe. The Client Senior Executive coordinates campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, helping to ensure consistent client service, robust operations and high-quality execution.</p> <p>XCM is Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division, delivering communications for Amazon.com, including major campaigns such as Black Friday and Prime Day. OpenDoor is XCM’s media partner worldwide, excluding North America and Latin America. As Europe is the largest region supported by the WPP team, the Regional XCM Client Senior Executive plays an important role in coordinating consistent delivery across markets.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>Collaboration across OpenDoor and the wider WPP network is central to the role, with a strong focus on best practice, operational consistency and on-time delivery.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Campaign delivery and coordination:</strong> Coordinate regional XCM campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions across client, internal and local market teams.</li> <li><strong>Client service and communication:</strong> Act as a professional point of contact for client enquiries and requests, providing clear updates on campaign progress, deliverables and performance.</li> <li><strong>Regional planning and reporting:</strong> Coordinate the accurate and timely delivery of regional plans and reports, including weekly spend trackers, performance reports and campaign status updates.</li> <li><strong>Operational setup and governance:</strong> Set up and maintain reporting templates, trackers, campaign documentation and ways of working; coordinate inputs, complete quality checks and support consistent data and processes across markets.</li> <li><strong>Finance and billing:</strong> Support finance processes by collating purchase orders, maintaining budget trackers, monitoring client billing, and escalating discrepancies or missing information.</li> <li><strong>Meetings and follow-up:</strong> Participate in and facilitate regular client, internal and creative agency meetings, preparing agendas and materials and documenting actions, owners and deadlines.</li> <li>Communicate Global Campaign guidelines to local market teams, clarify requirements and support consistent implementation across markets.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with regional departments, local OpenDoor teams and wider WPP partners, working effectively across locations and time zones.</li> <li>Develop a strong understanding of Amazon’s ways of working and the OpenDoor operating model to improve organisation, quality and consistency.</li> <li>Identify and share best-in-class work from across the network, helping regional clients and local markets adopt effective approaches.</li> <li>Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and work with the line manager to set objectives aligned with the role and agency vision.</li> </ul> <p>QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</p> <ul> <li>2–3 years’ experience in media planning, client management or account coordination, preferably within a network agency.</li> <li>Excellent organisational and project planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with close attention to detail.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and collaborate effectively.</li> <li>Awareness of the media and marketing industry, including key channels, emerging trends and planning principles.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and geographically distributed working environment.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.</li> <li>Ability to manage defined tasks independently and present outputs directly to clients or package them clearly for the wider team.</li> </ul> <p>BONUS POINTS</p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting multi-market or regional accounts.</li> <li>Experience with campaign reporting, budget tracking, operational governance or workflow tools.</li> <li>Familiarity with Amazon’s ecosystem, ways of working and Leadership Principles.</li> <li>Understanding of cross-channel media planning and how individual channels contribute to an integrated plan.</li> </ul> <p>BENEFITS OF OPENDOOR</p> <ul> guidance from experienced professionals at both WPP and Amazon.</li> <li><strong>Cutting-Edge Technology:</strong> Utilise industry-leading tools and platforms, including WPP Open.</li>
