title: Commerce Account Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3071 - Commerce Account Director</strong></p> <p><strong>About Wavemaker: A leading WPP Media brand</strong></p> <p>Grounded in analytics & insights and powered by data & technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and impact</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Account Leadership & Delivery<br></strong>Lead the end-to-end output of the team across client-facing work and operational delivery. Ensure consistently high standards, with strong adherence to processes, controls, and best practices.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Planning & Business Understanding<br></strong>Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, objectives, and KPIs. Apply this to shape effective, insight-led retail media strategies that drive measurable outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Retail Media Platform Expertise (Amazon, Citrus, Criteo)<br></strong>Demonstrate strong experience working across key retail media platforms including Amazon, CitrusAd, and Criteo. Apply platform expertise to guide planning, optimisation, and performance, ensuring best-in-class execution across search and display channels.</li> <li><strong>Tesco Retail Media SME Leadership<br></strong>Act as the subject matter expert for Tesco retail media, overseeing full-funnel activity and ensuring a cohesive approach from awareness through to conversion. Provide strategic guidance to both internal teams and clients on Tesco capabilities, opportunities, and best practices.</li> <li><strong>Innovation & Proactive Thinking<br></strong>Stay informed on industry trends, platform developments, and new product releases. Proactively identify and introduce opportunities to enhance client performance and maintain a competitive edge.</li> <li><strong>Client & Partner Relationship Management<br></strong>Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and media partners. Act as a trusted point of contact, confidently contributing insights and recommendations beyond immediate scope.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Development<br></strong>Support and develop a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative and accountable working environment. Take an active role in coaching, performance management, and career progression.</li> <li><strong>Communication Leadership<br></strong>Lead day-to-day communications across clients, partners, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear alignment and effective delivery. Engage senior leadership when required.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence & Process Improvement<br></strong>Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency through better processes, automation, and adoption of tools and technology.</li> <li><strong>Financial & Process Ownership<br></strong>Oversee activation-related financial processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery across all campaigns.</li> <li><strong>Measurement & Performance<br></strong>Maintain a strong understanding of measurement frameworks and partner capabilities. Use this knowledge to guide optimisation strategies and performance discussions with clients.</li> <li><strong>Workshops & Strategic Contribution<br></strong>Lead and contribute to client workshops and planning sessions, bringing structured thinking, insight, and strategic direction.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Team Collaboration<br></strong>Work closely with cross-functional teams (including GOC) to ensure seamless integration and consistent, high-quality execution across all workstreams.</li> <li><strong>Retail Media Integration<br></strong>Play a key role in embedding retail media within broader client strategies, identifying opportunities to connect activity across the wider marketing mix, including audience planning in systems such as Sphere and Nectar 360.</li> <li><strong>Partner & Product Development<br></strong>Support the development and testing of commerce products and solutions in collaboration with partners such as Skai, ensuring continued innovation and relevance.</li> <li><strong>Personal Development<br></strong>Set clear objectives with your line manager and demonstrate ongoing growth in leadership, strategic thinking, and client impact.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong> </p> <p>At WPP Media, our culture and people are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, it is essential to embody WPP and WPP Media’s core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary</strong> by leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open Environment</strong> by balancing people and client needs, cultivating trust and collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Lead Optimistically</strong> by championing growth and development to drive progress across the business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Strong experience in <strong>eCommerce and retail media</strong>, including campaign set-up, management, optimisation, and reporting across both media owner and technology vendor platforms.</li> <li>Excellent understanding of the <strong>strategic and tactical application of retail media and digital marketing</strong>, with the ability to translate this into effective client solutions.</li> <li>Proven hands-on experience across key platforms, including <strong>Amazon, Criteo, and CitrusAd</strong>, with a solid understanding of the wider UK retail landscape (e.g. Tesco, Sainsbury’s, ASDA, Morrisons, Ocado) and quick commerce partners (e.g. Deliveroo, Uber Eats).</li> <li>Experience working with <strong>bid management platforms</strong> such as Skai and/or Pacvue.</li> <li>Experience with planning and activation across search/sponsored product and DSP.</li> <li>Experience with AMC for audience and insight a bonus.</li> <li>Demonstrated <strong>project management and team leadership experience</strong>, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver against deadlines.</li> <li>Strong <strong>stakeholder management skills</strong>, with experience coordinating across clients, internal teams, and external partners.</li> <li>High level of <strong>data literacy</strong>, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into clear strategic recommendations.</li> <li>Strong <strong>attention to detail</strong>, ensuring accuracy and quality across all outputs.</li> <li>Confident <strong>communication and storytelling skills</strong>, able to present ideas and strategies clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Effective <strong>team management capabilities</strong>, including workload prioritisation, clear communication, and supporting team development.</li> <li>A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with the ability to remain <strong>calm under pressure</strong> and navigate complex or fast-paced environments.</li> <li>A genuine drive to <strong>elevate work beyond the expected</strong>, bringing energy, curiosity, and continuous improvement to the role.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong> </p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  </p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em> </p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide. </p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.  </p> <p>#LI-Promoted </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.co

title: Associate Director, Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3188 - Associate Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>We are recruiting for an Account Director who is an exceptional and driven media planner, to join our Connections Planning team.</p> <p>For bp you will work as part of the wider WPP inter-agency team, ‘Team Energy’, primarily across Retail, Fuel, Loyalty campaigns, as well as their new and exciting electric charging offering – bp Pulse. Regarding the planning work specifically, the bp account offers the opportunity to build internal and external agency exposure and further establish project management skills through management of multiple campaigns across multiple business units.</p> <p>We foster a highly collaborative environment with brilliant, forward-thinking clients who are not only engaged but genuinely enthusiastic about pushing boundaries. This partnership allows us to deliver truly exciting, market-leading work that sets industry benchmarks and drives significant impact.</p> <p>Expect a role that is highly strategic, requiring deep analytical thinking, a keen commercial eye, and a flair for innovative solutions. We are consistently exploring new technologies, channels, and audience engagement models, ensuring your work remains at the cutting edge. Innovation is not just encouraged, it's expected.</p> <p>Crucially, you'll have seamless access to a rich tapestry of agency expertise. You'll collaborate daily with our specialist teams in data science, advanced measurement & analytics, brand strategy, and consumer insights. This integrated approach empowers you to craft media plans that are not only creative and impactful but also deeply informed, measurable, and strategically sound.</p> <p><strong><u>About the role</u></strong></p> <p>You will be expected to demonstrate experience and knowledge in -</p> <ul> <li>Knowing the tools and means to build and target audiences in addressable and non-addressable media to validate the media approach ensuring that the defined audience can be reached at the scale required</li> <li>Designing an approach that outlines how and where we will connect with defined audiences – especially hard to reach / low media engagement audiences – in media for brand and performance campaigns.</li> <li>Connecting the dots between the data we, the client, media owners and other internal teams hold to plan most effectively.</li> <li>Designing the connections ecosystem & plan, working closely and collaboratively with channel specialists and wider agency teams from a paid, owned and earned perspective</li> <li>Day to day management of campaigns and annual planning as a key liaison between clients and channel specialists</li> <li>Designing measurement & testing framework to inform as well as measure and optimise the campaigns when live</li> <li>Management of others to develop their skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. title: Senior Localization Specialist, Italian
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About Taskrabbit:</strong></span></h2> <p>Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.</p> <p>At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.</p> <p>Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!</p></div><p><strong>This role is based in London and candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. Taskrabbit is a hybrid company, with employees working 2 days per week in our dedicated office space in Central London (Soho). </strong></p> <p> </p> <h3>About the role:</h3> <p>The Globalization team sits within the Product organization and ensures the Taskrabbit experience is fully localized and culturally resonant across all our international markets: Canada, the UK, France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, and Italy. We are growth partners and brand guardians for Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and Tasker Operations, among many other departments, elevating brand recognition and unlocking net revenue everywhere.</p> <p>We are seeking an experienced Senior Localization Specialist to join the team, managing all localization needs with expertise on the Italian locale. In this role, you will balance global localization project management across all markets, including high-touch, complex requests outside our automated pipeline, with full ownership of your language. You will be a strategic architect of our international presence: serving as the cultural bridge between our global product and the Italian market, ensuring our mission to transform lives feels assolutamente autentica, and collaborating with the wider Italian team to bring a strategy to life. You will coordinate translation work with our dedicated external agencies and contractors, and you will also adapt, proofread, edit, or transcreate content. Ideally, you will also contribute creatively to content development by writing original copy.</p> <p>You will own the evolution of our linguistic assets with the rest of the Globalization team, including glossaries, style guides, but also multilingual guidelines and resources used by all departments. As an internal consultant, you will support stakeholders with expert guidance on cultural nuances and globalization best practices across all territories.</p> <p>As part of our small but mighty international team, you will enjoy the autonomy to truly shape your role while exploring and implementing innovative tech solutions. Taskrabbit is a data-driven and values-driven company; your work will have a direct impact on the progress of our business and the lives of the communities we serve across all our markets.</p> <p> </p> <h3>What you will work on:</h3> <ul> <li>Manage global localization workflows on Smartling across all markets and locales, with dedicated in-house oversight and review for Italian.</li> <li>Orchestrate work with our dedicated translation agencies and build deep, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Develop and maintain reference materials for linguists, to keep a consistent voice in your locale and ensure best practices.</li> <li>Perform Quality Assurance checks to ensure our comms, resources and UX are of the highest standard and they adhere to our linguistic assets.</li> <li>Adapt and/or review content directly on our TMS (Smartling).</li> <li>Test and assess AI-driven workflows to scale our operations and improve efficiency, while maintaining localization quality.</li> <li>Carry out comprehensive localization audits, testing the full user journey to remove friction and enhance the customer experience and our performance metrics.</li> <li>Project manage cross-functional international initiatives, working with remote teams in different areas and time zones.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>What we are looking for:</h3> <ul> <li>An Italian localization expert.</li> <li>A passion for language, communication, and storytelling.</li> <li>A minimum of 5 years hands-on localization experience, with a strong background in translation, linguistics, transcreation, content creation, QA, and cultural adaptation.</li> <li>Excellent communication and organization skills. You are capable of carrying out all duties in a fast-paced environment as part of a hybrid international team.</li> <li>Solid understanding of CAT tools, including familiarity with MT and AI-driven workflows and tools.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to move from reactive translation management to proactive global strategy, identifying and solving complex workflow and content challenges.</li> <li>An experienced project manager, capable of working cross-functionally, managing expectations, understanding priorities, and delivering on time.</li> <li>A seasoned specialist who understands the nature, needs and nuances of different content types: Marketing, Product and Engineering, Customer Support, Partnerships, etc.</li> <li>A forensic eye for detail and a strong curiosity about how things work.</li> <li>A clear, kind, and considerate professional who takes pride in a job well done.</li> <li>A team player—You’ll be joining a small, cohesive team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Compensation & Benefits: </strong></h2> <p>At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + <a href="https://www.taskrabbit.com/careers">benefits + perks.</a></p> <p>The base pay range for this position is <strong>£49,000 - $£60,000. </strong>This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>You’ll love working here because:</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company.</strong> We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.</li> <li><strong>The People.</strong> You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!</li> <li><strong>The Diverse Culture.</strong> We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.</li> <li><strong>The Perks.</strong> Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. <strong>Benefits vary by country of employment. </strong></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:</strong></span></h2> <p>An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.</p> <p>Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. </p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>AI-Assisted Prescreening Notice [US Based Candidates Only]</strong>: As part of our hiring process, we may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the initial prescreening of applications and responses. This tool does not make hiring decisions — every application and response is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team to determine fit for the role. If you would prefer not to have your application processed using this tool, you may opt out by selecting 'opt out' in the application form or by emailing <a ---------- and your application will be reviewed manually with no impact on your candidacy.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor helping tech-forward companies build on the Claude Developer Platform as they grow and scale. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with engineering teams to help them develop their products on top of Claude - advising on implementation, agent design, and working alongside them to build at the frontier of AI.<br><br>Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers through deep technical engagements. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable tech-forward businesses to succeed with Claude.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-growth, tech-forward companies, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI</p> </li> <li> <p>Work hands-on with customer engineering teams: pair programming, architecture reviews, and code contributions that accelerate their development</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop prototypes and technical documentation—including evaluation suites, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams—that enable customers to build and scale with Claude</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements</p> </li> <li> <p>Identify patterns across engagements and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, and the broader Applied AI team</p> </li> <li> <p>Create technical content for developer audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code</p> </li> <li> <p>Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and developer-focused events</p> </li> <li> <p>Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and relationship building</p> </li> </ul> <h3><br><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in a customer-facing or pre-sales technical role - partnering with customers to scope, design, and deliver solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python and experience building production applications</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with high-growth, tech-forward companies</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to context-switch across industries (healthcare, fintech, etc.) and use cases</p> </li> <li> <p>Builder credibility that earns trust with technical founders and engineering leaders - you've shipped products and can speak from experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience facilitating technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events</p> </li> <li> <p>Passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£225,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£255,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p>As a <strong>Senior Search Engineer</strong> on our <strong>Discovery Team</strong>, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.</p> <p>Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend.</li> <li>Develop in a scalable and multi-tenant architecture.</li> <li>Analyze user needs and discuss technical approaches.</li> <li>Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps.</li> <li>Take part in on-call rotations with a worldwide distributed team for production systems</li> </ul> <p><em>This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our</em><strong><em> Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia</em></strong><em> office. </em></p> <h4><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer working in search.</li> <li>Experience with building search solutions on top of engines, such as Elasticsearch (preferred), Solr, OpenSearch, or similar.</li> <li>Aspiration to constantly improve yourself and learn new technologies, concepts, etc.</li> <li>Fluent English communication skills to work in international teams.</li> <li>AI Aptitude<strong>:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience using modern search stacks and strategies to optimize search relevance (Vector and Hybrid Search, Learning to rank, Re-ranker)</li> <li>Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures (incl., queues, notification topics, sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover).</li> <li>Experience working with Scala or other functional programming languages.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust. </li> </ul> </div> </section> </div> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success </p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. </p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>. </p> </div> </section> </div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h1><strong>Senior Data Scientist - Growth</strong></h1> <h2><strong>What's the opportunity? </strong></h2> <p>The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Fin use data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small  to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. If you get really excited about asking the right questions, exploring patterns in data and surfacing actionable insights that drive strategic decisions, then this role is for you.</p> <p>Growth Data Scientists in RAD partner with the product teams who own our self-serve signup flow, our trial experience and onboarding, our checkout flow and our Startup Programs. title: Staff Fullstack Data Analyst (Commercial Analytics)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: Applications will be open until 3rd October 2026 at 10.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing window so, please, don't rush to apply and ensure you use the time to submit a high quality, personalised application. About the role Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine — acquisition, retention, propensity modelling, and customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions. As a Staff Full Stack Data Analyst, you are the senior technical voice for commercial analytics at Pleo. You set the architectural direction for Growth Intelligence's analytics layer, define what good looks like for the team, and shape how GTM data is structured, governed, and consumed by people and increasingly by AI tools. You bring technical depth, commercial instinct, and organisational reach in equal measure. You move between architecture reviews and executive presentations, between defining metric contracts and mentoring the analysts who implement them. You don't just answer questions - you identify the right ones, and you make sure the answers compound over time. Who you'll work with You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner closely with senior commercial leadership, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams; the onboarding and self-serve product teams; Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers across the broader data organization; and Data Services & Governance on standards and semantic layer ownership. You will be a visible, senior presence across the entire data community at Pleo. What you'll be doing Own the architectural direction of the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention. You'll be making systemic decisions about how models are structured, layered, and governed, not just what gets built next. Identify and resolve upstream data quality issues at source, treating quality gaps as governance and contract problems, articulating the business risk they create, and driving the org-level changes needed to fix them durably. Define canonical GTM metric definitions in the semantic layer, in partnership with Data Services & Governance while ensuring RevOps, CS, CX, BI tools, and AI tooling are working from the same source of truth, and holding that standard over time. Partner with senior commercial leadership to shape the questions worth answering. Lead in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns. Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result. Build analytics explicitly architected for self-serve and AI access: structured, documented, and reliable enough for business teams, conversational analytics tools, and AI features to consume autonomously. Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft. Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo. For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally. What you bring Prior experience operating at Staff or Lead level in data analytics or analytics engineering roles in a fast-paced SaaS organisation. Expert knowledge of SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested, well-architected models and can make and defend layering decisions for a team, not just yourself. Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation. Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code. BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale. Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni. Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level. Systems thinking on data quality: you approach quality gaps as governance questions, identify root causes upstream, and drive fixes that last rather than patches that don't. Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick. Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and you know why metric consistency becomes critical as AI tooling scales. Track record of advising senior GTM stakeholders around shaping the question as much as answering it, and communicating risk and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders. Experience mentoring analysts and raising team capability Why this role is a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You excel at turning large, interconnected and complex problems into well structured, clearly defined and pragmatic solutions. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity within a fast-paced SaaS organisation, and can generate clarity, you'll find this role very exciting. You find hands-on technical work as exciting as stakeholders management, delivery management and governance strategy. You have operated as a Technical Lead for Commercial / Growth Analytics within a 500+ people SaaS organisation and understand the recurring topics, challenges and goals businesses of our scale experience. This role is NOT a good fit for you if: You prefer to specialise deeply in one technical area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between architecture, analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and mentoring. You are not comfortable operating at senior leadership level and shaping ambiguous commercial questions into solvable data problems. You'll often need to define what success looks like before you can measure it. You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex: definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires organisational negotiation as much as analysis. You think of standards and governance as someone else's job. At this level, you are part of how the organisation decides what good looks like. How you'll develop in this role By the end of your first six months, you will have left the analytics layer in structurally better shape, not just fixed individual dashboards, but addressed the underlying quality, governance, and architectural gaps that were causing repeated pain for RevOps, CS, and CX teams. You will have driven at least one meaningful governance outcome: canonical GTM metric definitions agreed with Data Services & Governance, embedded in the semantic layer, and actively used so that analysts, BI tools, and AI features are working from the same numbers. You will have established yourself as a trusted partner to commercial leadership, not just the person who delivers the analysis, but the person they bring in when they're not sure what question to ask. You will have shipped something that changed what was possible: not improved plumbing, but unlocked a capability or decision that couldn't have happened without you. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Core skills test: an async technical exercise designed to assess your coding fundamentals. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute experience-based interview to deep dive into your domain knowledge, technical expertise and ability to lead initiatives. Pleo Challenge: a live practical and technical case study designed to assess your domain knowledge, problem solving, and insights generation skills. Final interview: a 30-minute conversation with a senior leader focusing on your behavioural skills. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background. Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. For this role, technical experience, seniority and commercial domain expertise all matter equally. Ensure your CV reflects the actual experience you have in each of these areas. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background. Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: About Bike Club We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. The Role We are looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Manager to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for the management of the performance marketing agency and overall delivery of our paid acquisition strategy. You will manage our agency partners, monitor channel performance and use customer and commercial data to recommend where we should invest, test and optimise. This role combines performance marketing expertise with strong commercial judgement. You will work closely with Marketing, Content, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial colleagues to improve the efficiency, quality and predictability of customer acquisition. You will be comfortable moving between strategic planning and detailed performance analysis, challenging agency recommendations and turning data into clear actions. Tasks What You'll Do - Acquisition Planning Develop and deliver Bike Club's customer acquisition plans across the UK and Germany in collaboration with the Marketing Director. Translate business objectives into channel plans, campaign targets and testing priorities. Recommend how acquisition budgets should be allocated across markets, channels and campaigns. Identify new opportunities to grow customer acquisition and market penetration. Develop a clear test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative, and landing pages. Continuously assess the effectiveness and scalability of acquisition channels**.** - Performance Marketing Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners ensuring they deliver against agreed objectives. Oversee the day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition activity across relevant channels. Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms. Review campaign plans, media spend, targeting, creative and results, constructively challenging agency recommendations where appropriate. Track customer acquisition cost, conversion, return on advertising spend and other key measures of performance. Focus acquisition activity on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers rather than simply driving volume. Work closely with the content team to develop strong campaign propositions, briefs and creative testing plans. Identify opportunities to improve landing pages and customer journeys. Ensure learning from campaigns and tests is documented and applied to future activity. - Commercial Performance & Data Own day-to-day reporting on acquisition KPIs, including CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value. Partner closely with Finance and Data to understand acquisition economics and profitability. Analyse performance by channel, audience, campaign, proposition and market. Develop robust forecasting and scenario planning for acquisition performance for the Marketing Director and wider business Ensure performance data is accurate, accessible and used consistently in decision-making. Present findings and recommendations clearly to both marketing specialists and wider business stakeholders. Requirements About You You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement. You'll bring: Relevant experience in performance marketing, customer acquisition or growth marketing within a consumer-focused business or agency. A strong understanding of paid acquisition channels and how they work together within the customer journey. Experience managing performance marketing agencies or external partners. A track record of improving acquisition performance while maintaining commercial discipline. Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations. Experience developing and evaluating campaign tests across audiences, creative, propositions or channels. Experience managing a multi-channel, multi-market budget of £1m+, including making investment recommendations A test-and-learn mindset and genuine curiosity about what drives customer behaviour. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working across multiple markets, ideally including Germany is desirable. What Success Looks Like In your first 12 months, you will have: Delivered the acquisition plan in the UK and Germany hitting targets and establishing ways of working for future growth. Improved the efficiency and predictability of customer acquisition. Established clear acquisition KPIs and reporting. Built an effective and accountable relationship with our performance marketing agency. Developed a structured programme of testing across channels, audiences, propositions and creative. Identified and scaled the strongest acquisition opportunities. Improved collaboration between Marketing, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial teams. Benefits 🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays 💷Pension salary sacrifice 🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave 🚴Employee Discount on our bikes Why BikeClub? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes. title: Financial Accountant (12 month FTC)
description: WHO WE ARE Trustly is leading the human centric payments revolution. To us, this means passionately building the most convenient, intelligent and responsible way of paying for things online. Whether it's for shopping, paying subscriptions, funding trading accounts, booking airfare, playing online games and much more, we're all about a better way to pay. At our core, we are a tech company with industry leading tech capabilities. But it's the ingenuity of our people that makes us leaders in our field. Thus, our appetite for innovation will never be anything less than fierce. Trustly is steadily growing as it connects thousands of businesses with hundreds of millions of people. And with a strong presence across Europe and the Americas, we are leading the human centric payment revolution as a truly global team. This role is in the Financial Reporting and Accounting team, part of the Group Internal Finance team at Trustly, which also comprises Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Operations and Finance Systems. The team has an ethos of collaboration and continued improvement at its heart. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a great opportunity for a qualified accountant with solid IFRS experience in industry to join our Financial Reporting and Accounting team on a fixed term basis, covering a period of increased workload within the team. You will take ownership of month-end and year-end close for a portfolio of entities, working closely with more senior members of the team and applying your existing technical accounting expertise from day one. Key Responsibilities Month End Close: Own the month end close process for assigned entities, preparing journals, reconciliations, and supporting schedules to a high standard and in compliance with relevant accounting standards. Financial Reporting: Preparing monthly/quarterly/annual commentaries for Balance Sheet and P&L variances. Audit Liaison: Support the year end audit process. Other: Actively participate in finance related projects, implement process improvements and collaborate closely with the wider Finance team, building relationships across Reporting, Tax, Treasury and FinOps. Qualifications The successful candidate will have: Availability to start on a short notice period. Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent, e.g. ROC for Portugal based candidates). Solid IFRS experience gained in an industry setting, with a strong understanding of how standards apply in a commercial context. Proven experience owning month end close processes end to end. Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical skills. Good working knowledge of Excel; exposure to accounting systems such as Netsuite is a plus but not essential. Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast paced international environment. Shape Your Role and Make an Impact Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We're looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation. Wolt's AdTech & Promotions team is building the systems that power how restaurants and brands grow on our platform. From campaign creation to optimization and forecasting, we develop tools that help advertisers make smarter decisions and drive measurable results. As we expand our offering, we are investing in new capabilities that combine real-time data, scalable systems, and intuitive user experiences to unlock the next phase of growth. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Wolt AdTech & Promotions organization, who can drive technical direction across this space and help us build reliable, scalable systems that directly impact revenue and advertiser success. What you'll be doing Drive the technical vision and architecture for Wolt's AdTech and Promotions platforms, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and high-performing. Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and projects, bringing architectural consistency to complex, large-scale systems. Work across the end-to-end domain , contributing to backend services, data pipelines, and advertiser-facing tools. Design and evolve systems that support campaign execution, targeting, ranking, allocation, and reporting in real-time or near real-time environments. Partner with engineering, product, and data stakeholders to align priorities, improve campaign performance, and manage trade-offs in a revenue-driven environment. Lead large cross-team projects, guiding them from concept to rollout across multiple regions and time zones. Ensure strong operational excellence, including observability, reliability, and incident readiness for revenue-critical systems. Promote best engineering practices, mentor engineers across teams, and support their growth in scalability and system design. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical colleagues, ensuring clarity and alignment across functions. Contribute to the technical roadmaps of AdTech and Promotions platforms by collaborating with other senior engineers. This position is based in London Our humble expectations Technical Expertise Proven track record designing and scaling large distributed systems in production environments . Strong understanding of system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization. Experience working with data-intensive and real-time or near real-time systems . Familiarity with AdTech concepts such as targeting, ranking, attribution, or experimentation is a strong plus. Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and languages; while many of our services are written in Kotlin and Go, we are looking for someone language-agnostic. Ability to dive quickly into new domains and navigate complex system interactions. Familiarity with modern cloud-native tools and data systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Kafka, MongoDB). Communication & Influence Strong communicator with the ability to influence, align, and build consensus across diverse teams and stakeholders. Comfortable working in a global environment across US and international teams . Skilled at translating complex technical decisions into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences. Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, helping raise the technical bar across teams. Strong sense of ownership combined with a collaborative mindset , able to work effectively across team boundaries to deliver shared outcomes. Proactive in identifying opportunities and gaps across teams , and driving alignment to solve problems holistically rather than locally. What we offer At Wolt, this role provides a rare opportunity to work on challenging AdTech problems at scale , where technical decisions directly impact revenue and user experience. Our compensation follows a total compensation model , combining a competitive base salary with DoorDash RSUs. You will play a key role in building and evolving the next generation of advertisement tools and platforms , shaping how advertisers create, manage, and optimize campaigns across Wolt. This is not just about maintaining systems, but about defining and scaling new capabilities in a fast-growing domain . As a Staff Engineer, you will have end-to-end ownership and high autonomy , with the ability to influence architecture, product direction, and engineering practices across teams. Your work will have clear, measurable business impact , directly contributing to revenue growth and advertiser success. You'll be part of a global company operating at scale , collaborating with teams across Europe and the US, and solving problems that span multiple markets, use cases, and customer segments. This role also offers strong opportunities for career growth and scope expansion , whether through deep technical leadership, cross-domain influence, or progression toward more senior individual contributor roles. Alongside the technical challenge, you'll work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse and international environment , shaping both our systems and engineering culture while mentoring and learning from others. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Job Title: Senior Influencer Executive - Germany</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Brand: Myprotein</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Company: THG Nutrition</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Location: THG HQ (WA15 0AF) Office based</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p data-start="99" data-end="134"><strong>About THG Nutrition:</strong></p> <p data-start="136" data-end="696" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">THG Nutrition is home to some of the best-loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, and its family of brands: Myvegan, Myvitamins, and MP Activewear. With Myprotein's slogan, <em data-start="420" data-end="440">Fuel your ambition</em>, at the heart of everything we do, we’re on a mission to be the world's most empowering health movement, championing everyone to live healthier, more active lives. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries, to power and empower those who want more.</p> <p data-start="143" data-end="197"><strong data-start="143" data-end="197">Why be a Senior Influencer Executive for Germany Myprotein?</strong></p> <p data-start="199" data-end="877">At Myprotein, we’re more than just a sports nutrition brand, we’re a global movement driven by passion, innovation and our mission to <em data-start="346" data-end="366">Fuel your ambition</em>. As Senior Influencer Executive for Germany, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the way our brand connects with an influential and growing fitness community. You’ll work alongside a passionate, high-performing marketing team and play a pivotal role in scaling our influencer strategy in one of our fastest-growing markets. This is a unique chance to blend creativity, strategic thinking, and cultural insight, all while working with some of the most exciting talent in the German fitness and wellbeing space.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities include:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-start="191" data-end="408">Own and drive the day-to-day operations of the German influencer programme, ensuring consistent growth and performance, while maintaining strong working relationships with creators and talent agents in the region.</li> <li data-start="412" data-end="587">Support the Senior Influencer Manager – EU in shaping and executing the German influencer strategy, aligning with overall EU and global objectives for the Myprotein brand.</li> <li data-start="591" data-end="815">Deliver detailed performance reporting on a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly basis, analysing key KPIs including engagement, reach, conversions and ROI, and presenting insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders.</li> <li data-start="819" data-end="999">Manage programme maintenance, ensuring influencer tracking links, discount codes, and promotional offers are accurate, live, and performing optimally across all communications.</li> <li data-start="1003" data-end="1238">Actively source and recruit new German influencer talent, with a focus on brand alignment, commercial potential, and cultural fit – from micro creators to emerging macro talent – to support customer acquisition and brand awareness.</li> <li data-start="1242" data-end="1466">Collaborate cross-functionally with key stakeholders including content, brand, commercial, paid media and product marketing teams to plan, brief, and execute integrated influencer campaigns tailored to the German market.</li> <li data-start="1470" data-end="1636">Own the full campaign process for German influencer activations – from planning and briefing, to execution, approvals, content collection, analysis and learnings.</li> <li data-start="1640" data-end="1828">Ensure influencer content is on-brand, high quality and aligned with current German social media trends, fitness culture and seasonal campaigns, maintaining relevance and authenticity.</li> <li data-start="1832" data-end="2028">Lead on German influencer payments and budget tracking, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing and monthly purchase order (PO) processes are completed in line with internal finance procedures.</li> <li data-start="2032" data-end="2256">Encourage collaboration across influencer tiers, nurturing an engaged community through creative activations, collaborative content opportunities and connections with wider marketing channels (e.g., events, social, CRM).</li> <li data-start="2260" data-end="2416">Support brand-led events, campaigns and content creation, ensuring German influencer presence and involvement is maximised to generate impact and reach.</li> <li data-start="2420" data-end="2610">Stay ahead of industry trends in Germany , identifying emerging platforms, content formats, and creator trends to future-proof Myprotein’s influencer approach and maintain brand relevance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Native level German language skills both written and spoken</li> <li>Business level English language skills both written and spoken</li> <li>Degree Qualified (Preferred)</li> <li>2+ year experience in Influencer marketing (preferred)</li> <li>A genuine interest in health, wellbeing, fitness and an ambition to be at the forefront of German influencer marketing</li> <li>An understanding of how influencers can play a key role in building brand awareness, affinity, content creation and driving commercial value for brands</li> <li>Deep knowledge of current and emerging German social media platforms including but not limited to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok etc.</li> <li>Outstanding communication, negotiation and organisational skills</li> <li>A proactive self-starter with a problem-solving attitude and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Knowledge of the German fitness industry and social media trends</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access our in-house CBT therapist.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Access to on-site barber.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.</li> <li>Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":279}">#LI-ONSITE</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
